analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges with software and hardware compatibility involving [product_name] and [article_no]. The application requests a newer software version but doesn't specify which one, creating confusion about update procedures and correct hardware settings, which affects both upgrading and deploying processes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clarity on which [product_name] version matches their [article_no] hardware, direct guidance for obtaining the correct software, and a straightforward program transfer process without compatibility issues.
